reviews.title: Gamer gift
reviews.comment: I bought this for my husband. He loves playing video games and the picture quality he says its amazing for the price. The brightness adjust very good. Quality of the monitor is good and sturdy. Appearance is like a normal monitor, side ways looks very thin. Color quality is the same as the picture. The sound quality is good as well, my husband normally wears headphones but for some days he does not and the volume and quality is perfect.
reviews.author: Aneb

reviews.title: Good value, good picture
reviews.comment: It's a really good monitor. It's does move to face upwards more if necessary for you and your set up.  The information about it seems to hold up after a few weeks with the monitor I'm very satisfied with my purchase! It's got a very clear image as well. I play a lot of mix of games and it handles all of them well from more visually stressful games to Minecraft at whatever settings I wanna put it on with as many shaders I require on it. Works for me.
reviews.author: Holly

reviews.title: Amazing deal for the specs
reviews.comment: 5 stars for that price to performance ratio alone. My biggest gripe is the button layout makes no sense but that doesn't matter after you dial everything in. Supports HDR and came with a display port cable, neither of which were advertised. The stand can only adjust vertically but the attachment is a standard vesa mount.
reviews.author: Tim Mower

reviews.title: Shipping is Disappointimg
reviews.comment:
I ordered two and rec’d one yesterday.  The second was supposed to be delivered today, but Amazon shipping failed once again to deliver when they say they will.
Other than that disappointment, it seems to be a very nice monitor.  Very clear, vivid colors… shipping reliability just leaves a bad taste….
reviews.author: Nanny4Two

reviews.title: Good budget/performance balance
reviews.comment: Great value! Best price/quality balance for people who want good quality without breaking the bank.
reviews.author: Logan
